services.name: Kraken Hosting
services.blurb: Game server hosting. I used to run the infrastructure, DevOps, and development mostly myself. Now it's co-run by a couple friends and I.

services.name: Heed the light
services.blurb: A minecraft mod I made for a friend that damages you while in the darkness for too long, meant for his horror modpack streams.

services.name: LogForge
services.blurb: A web app that reads Minecraft logs and explains what went wrong.

services.name: DM Screen
services.blurb: A website for D&D DMs to manage rolls, players, enemies, notes, etc. (This was my first web project)

services.name: Custom 80% keyboard
services.blurb: A keyboard PCB I designed from scratch in KiCad for the Hack Club Keeb program (I never shipped it :sad:).

services.name: Ignis
services.blurb: A voice assistant that runs entirely on your own machine.

services.name: Bolt
services.blurb: A mod I made for the game "Screw Drivers" dedicated server to add actual admin features.
